meta.title: Neck Pain & Cervical Rehabilitation | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Reducing neck pain and restoring flexibility and function.

overview: Neck pain, whether from poor posture, disc degeneration, whiplash or cervical radiculopathy, is one of the most common musculoskeletal complaints and one that often responds well to expert physiotherapy.

At Cambridge Hospital, our outpatient musculoskeletal therapy services offer comprehensive cervical spine assessment, manual therapy, mobilisation techniques, nerve-root management, postural retraining and ergonomic guidance. For post-surgical cervical cases, structured inpatient and outpatient rehabilitation programmes are available.
